steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Add the requested CYLINDER line item with quantity 10.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Add the available QA test vendor audience required for publishing.
Publish the RFQ so participant management is available on the live event.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Open the live RFQ participant management screen.

args.goal: save the participant audience without changing any participant selection, then stop when the screen shows the no-change result "No change in Audience"

steps.note: Perform the unchanged audience save in the buyer session.
Assert the product reports that the audience did not change.
